title: ActionPlanTemplate - Data API
description: Represents the instance of an action plan template. This object is available in API version 44.0 and later.

ActionPlanType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
ActionPlanType.description: This action plan template’s type. Possible values are: Industries Sales—This value is available in API version 63.0 and later with the Sales Action Plans add-on license and the Sales Action Plans default permission set. Service

Category.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Category.description: Specifies the category that the action plan template belongs to.Available in API version 64.0 and later. Possible values are: Onboarding Application

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: The description of this action plan template.

EstimatedCompletionDays.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EstimatedCompletionDays.description: The estimated number of days to complete the action plan.Available in API version 64.0 and later.

FileBasedTemplatePath.description: The path of the file based template using which the action plan template is created.Available in API version 64.0 and later.

IsAdHocItemCreationEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsAdHocItemCreationEnabled.description: Indicates whether users can add tasks or other items to generated action plans (true) or not (false).

IsLocked.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsLocked.description: Indicates whether this action plan template is locked or not. The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed this record.

MayEdit.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
MayEdit.description: Indicates whether this action plan template can be edited or not. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of this action plan template.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns this action plan template. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

SourceType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
SourceType.description: Specifies the source type to which the action plan template belongs to.Available in API version 64.0 and later. Possible values are: CRM MigratedFromSandbox

Status.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
Status.description: The status of this action plan template. Possible values are: Draft Final—Published Obsolete ReadOnly

Subcategory.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Subcategory.description: The subcategory to which the action plan template belongs.Available in API version 64.0 and later. Possible values are: Product Onboarding Customer Onboarding

UniqueName.description: The unique name for this action plan template. This field is unique within your organization.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **ActionPlanTemplateChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **ActionPlanTemplateFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **ActionPlanTemplateHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **ActionPlanTemplateOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **ActionPlanTemplateShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
